sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining silently returns nil when any link in the chain is absent
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through layers of connection, only for the whole chain to resolve to nothing the moment one link is missing.

sketches.mechanism: The 'else' clause on a for loop executes only when the loop completes without breaking — meaning it runs when what you searched for was never found
sketches.resonance: The else block is the quiet aftermath of searching through everything and finding no reason to stop.

sketches.mechanism: The 'Nothing' type is the bottom type — a function returning Nothing can never actually return, it can only throw or loop forever
sketches.resonance: To promise Nothing is the one promise you must keep forever: you can never come back from it.
